_about: Labeled retrieval evaluation set. Each entry: query, expected (exact section_title, or null for off-topic queries that must return nothing), category, and note explaining why the case is here. Section titles must match kb_chunks.section_title exactly - eval_retrieval.py validates this before scoring and refuses to run on a stale label.

_history_note: Entries with a 'history' field are pronoun-only follow-ups. They are evaluated through app.rag.pipeline._build_retrieval_query, which folds recent user turns into the query before embedding - so these test the augmented-query path, not cold retrieval. A follow-up scored without its history would be meaningless.
_language_note: The knowledge base is stored in both English and Arabic (see knowledge_base_ar.md), and retrieval answers a question from the half matching its script. So an Arabic query's expected section is the ARABIC section title, not the English one. Arabizi entries keep English expectations on purpose: Arabizi is Latin script, so it is served from the English half, and that is the behaviour being measured.
